acceptance_criteria.criterion: no trusted workflow invokes bootstrap_external_review_469.py after cutover
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tests/test_authority_cutover_contract.py proves no trusted workflow invokes the legacy bridge; DFF-028 enforces recurrence prevention.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: governance review and governance reconcile invoke only the canonical governance controller for current governance truth
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Both workflows invoke hunter_governance_review_v2.py directly; cutover contract and DFF-028 guard enforce the single-owner path.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: merge readiness invokes only the canonical readiness projector
acceptance_criteria.evidence: hunter-merge-readiness.yml invokes hunter_merge_readiness_v2.py directly; cutover contract and DFF-028 enforce it.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: privileged reviewer dispatch remains only on a trusted default-branch workflow with actions: write; the pr-reachable governance lane remains read-only for actions
acceptance_criteria.evidence: actions: write remains only on trusted reconcile; PR-reachable governance review retains actions: read and cannot dispatch.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: the enabled reviewer pool is ordered and bounded, with explicit ack and review timeouts and no automatic authority retry loop
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented and covered by reviewer/cutover/DPM regression tests; 574 focused tests passed on implementation commit 386fba2 before request minting.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: hermes is in the real pool, runs on the trusted mac reviewer lane, and remains authority_eligible=false until its benchmark passes
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Hermes is configured in CODE_WRITE_POLICY and hunter-hermes-reviewer.yml with authority_eligible=false until its benchmark passes.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: a definitively missing/offline/busy self-hosted runner fails over without consuming the full review timeout
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Collector probes self-hosted runner state and immediately records unavailable for missing/offline/busy; regression coverage verifies no dispatch/full timeout burn.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: unknown runner/provider availability cannot be promoted to success and must use the authenticated invocation/ack path
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Unknown probe state falls through to authenticated dispatch/ACK rather than being guessed; regression coverage verifies the path.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: provider unavailable/rate-limited/ack-timeout/execution-failed outcomes never count as code findings or review authority
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Reviewer dispatch and collector classify provider failures separately from clear/findings and never admit them as authority.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: review authority requires authenticated exact-head, exact-claims, acknowledged evidence from an authority-eligible reviewer
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Authority receipt validation requires authenticated + acknowledged + exact head + exact claims + authority-eligible capability.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: pool exhaustion is explicit fail-closed state, not a fabricated code failure and not merge ready
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Existing orchestration fail-closed POOL_EXHAUSTED semantics remain intact and merge readiness does not treat exhaustion as ready.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: existing #482 reviewer-unavailability and prerequisite lifecycle fixes remain intact through the cutover
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Existing DFF-025/026/027 collector/prerequisite lifecycle tests remain green in the 574-test focused suite.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: targeted governance/reviewer/dpm/cutover regressions and impact-selected regressions are green before one final full-suite acceptance run
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 574 focused governance/reviewer/DPM/cutover tests passed before request minting; final full-suite remains an acceptance step.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: no autonomous merge, production deployment, or bypass is introduced; merge remains explicit human authority
acceptance_criteria.evidence: No merge/deploy/bypass action is introduced; production entry remains explicit human merge authority.
